title: Clients
description: Master data shared by every employee: who to talk to, what each client is billed and which invoices are still open. Employees reference clients by id.

health.overdue: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
health.dueIn: {count, plural, =0 {due today} one {due in # day} other {due in # days}}

reason.deadline_soon: Deadline in less than 14 days with progress below 70%

emptyHelp: Add the companies you work for: employees use them for status reports, minutes and invoices.

detail.notFound: This client doesn't exist (or belongs to another workspace).

quick.statusBrief: Write a status report for {name}: for each active project, the progress, what was done since the last report, next steps and any risks or decisions needed from the client. Email it to {name}'s contacts who receive status reports (the email goes through approval).
quick.invoiceBrief: Prepare and send the next invoice for {name}. Check the invoice ledger for the next number and what is still open, use the company's default tax, and send it to {name}'s contacts who receive invoices (the email goes through approval).

contacts.help: Who to talk to at this client, and which mail each person gets. Employees send status reports, minutes and invoices to the ticked contacts.

recurring.help: On its day each billing drafts an invoice (numbered from the company profile) and asks a person to approve sending it.
recurring.dialogHelp: The invoice is drafted at 08:00 on the chosen day (workspace time) and waits in Approvals until someone sends it.
recurring.recipientsHelp: Leave empty to send to the contacts who receive invoices (or the client's main email).
recurring.dueAfter: {count, plural, =0 {due on receipt} one {due after # day} other {due after # days}}
recurring.confirmDelete: Delete the recurring billing "{name}"? Invoices already drafted stay in the ledger.

invoices.emptyHelp: Invoices appear here once an employee drafts or sends one, or a recurring billing runs.
invoices.confirmVoid: Void invoice {number}? It stays in the ledger but no longer counts as outstanding.

history.empty: Nothing has happened with this client yet

company.title: Company profile
company.description: Printed on every invoice: who is billing, where to pay, and how invoices are numbered.
company.readOnly: Printed on every invoice. Only Admins can change it.
company.defaultTaxHelp: Used when an invoice doesn't say otherwise, e.g. 11 for PPN.
company.invoiceFooterPlaceholder: e.g. Thank you for your business. Please include the invoice number with your payment.
